```yaml
name: Backend Required Checks

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]

jobs:
  # Path classification job to determine which gates should run
  path-classification:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      backend: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.backend }}
      frontend: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.frontend }}
      e2e: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.e2e }}
      coverage: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.coverage }}
      security: ${{ steps.classify.outputs.security }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
      
      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: tj-actions/changed-files@v42
        with:
          files: |
            **/*.py
            **/requirements*.txt
            **/Dockerfile
            **/docker-compose.yml
            **/Makefile
            **/pyproject.toml
            **/setup.py
            **/tox.ini
            **/bandit.yml
            **/security/**
            **/tests/**
      
      - name: Classify paths
        id: classify
        run: |
          BACKEND=false
          FRONTEND=false
          E2E=false
          COVERAGE=false
          SECURITY=false
          
          for file in ${{ steps.changed-files.outputs.all_changed_files }}; do
            if [[ "$file" == *"tldw_Server_API/"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"requirements"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"Dockerfile"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"docker-compose.yml"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"Makefile"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"pyproject.toml"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"setup.py"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"tox.ini"* ]]; then
              BACKEND=true
            fi
            
            if [[ "$file" == *"frontend/"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"static/"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"templates/"* ]]; then
              FRONTEND=true
            fi
            
            if [[ "$file" == *"e2e/"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"integration/"* ]]; then
              E2E=true
            fi
            
            if [[ "$file" == *"coverage/"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"tests/coverage"* ]]; then
              COVERAGE=true
            fi
            
            if [[ "$file" == *"security/"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"bandit.yml"* ]] || [[ "$file" == *"dependency-review"* ]]; then
              SECURITY=true
            fi
          done
          
          echo "backend=$BACKEND" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "frontend=$FRONTEND" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "e2e=$E2E" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "coverage=$COVERAGE" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "security=$SECURITY" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  # Backend quality gate - conditional on changed Python files
  backend-quality-gate:
    needs: path-classification
    if: needs.path-classification.outputs.backend == 'true' || github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'
          cache: 'pip'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pytest bandit
      
      - name: Run CI contract tests
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest -q -c /dev/null --confcutdir=tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -o cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache-ci tldw_Server_API/tests/CI
      
      - name: Security scan with Bandit
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate && python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -s B101 -f json -o /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json

  # Security gate - conditional on security-related changes
  security-gate:
    needs: path-classification
    if: needs.path-classification.outputs.security == 'true' || github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
      - name: Dependency Review
        uses: actions/dependency-review-action@b74851a165d22011101110111011101110111011
        with:
          fail-on-severity: high
          deny-licenses: GPL-1.0-or-later, GPL-2.0-or-later, GPL-3.0-or-later
          allow-ghsas: |
            GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx
            GHSA-yyyy-yyyy-yyyy

  # Frontend quality gate - conditional on frontend changes
  frontend-quality-gate:
    needs: path-classification
    if: needs.path-classification.outputs.frontend == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
      
      - name: No-op pass for frontend changes
        run: |
          echo "Frontend changes detected - passing required check"
          exit 0

  # E2E quality gate - conditional on E2E changes
  e2e-quality-gate:
    needs: path-classification
    if: needs.path-classification.outputs.e2e == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
      
      - name: No-op pass for E2E changes
        run: |
          echo "E2E changes detected - passing required check"
          exit 0

  # Coverage quality gate - conditional on coverage changes
  coverage-quality-gate:
    needs: path-classification
    if: needs.path-classification.outputs.coverage == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2
      
      - name: No-op pass for coverage changes
        run: |
          echo "Coverage changes detected - passing required check"
          exit 0

  # Required checks summary
  required-checks-summary:
    needs: [path-classification, backend-quality-gate, security-gate, frontend-quality-gate, e2e-quality-gate, coverage-quality-gate]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: always()
    steps:
      - name: Summary of required checks
        run: |
          echo "Path classification results:"
          echo "Backend: ${{ needs.path-classification.outputs.backend }}"
          echo "Frontend: ${{ needs.path-classification.outputs.frontend }}"
          echo "E2E: ${{ needs.path-classification.outputs.e2e }}"
          echo "Coverage: ${{ needs.path-classification.outputs.coverage }}"
          echo "Security: ${{ needs.path-classification.outputs.security }}"
          
          echo "All required checks completed successfully"
```
